Cash is just above the $500 threshold and 3 slots are open, so I'm putting it into one medium-conviction buy, SYRE, which spreads risk beyond our tech-heavy holdings. All 7 current positions stay. market_education.summary_en: The NASDAQ rose 0.3% while the S&P 500 fell 0.3%, so growth and tech stocks outperformed the broader market. Many security and cloud software names on our screener, such as NET, CRWD, OKTA, ZS and QLYS, show bullish momentum signals, which points to money moving into tech rather than out of the market as a whole. No news headlines were provided today, so this explanation is based only on price and technical data.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市方向分歧：納斯達克指數微升0.3%，標普500指數則微跌0.3%，顯示資金偏向成長股及科技股，而非全面撤離市場。從篩選結果可見，NET、CRWD、OKTA、ZS、QLYS等網絡安全及雲端軟件股普遍呈現強勢動能訊號，反映板塊輪動跡象明顯。由於今日未有相關新聞資料，以上分析僅依據價格及技術指標數據。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Index divergence is when major market indexes move in opposite directions on the same day, as the NASDAQ rose and the S&P 500 fell today. It usually means investors are moving money between sectors, for example into tech and out of other industries, rather than buying or selling the whole market. A good response is to be selective and favor stocks with strong signals of their own instead of betting on the market as a whole.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 指數背馳是指主要股市指數在同一日走勢相反，例如今日納指上升而標普500下跌。這通常代表資金正在板塊之間輪動，例如由其他行業流入科技股，而非整體市場同步買入或沽出。面對這種市況，投資者宜精挑細選個股，優先考慮本身技術訊號強勁的股票，而非押注大市整體方向。
